name: comp-62
blurb: Textarea with Optional hint aligned to the right.
description: A textarea with label on the left and 'Optional' hint on the right, using flex justify-between. Shows the field is not required.
use_when: Multi-line fields in forms where you want to indicate they are optional.
avoid_when: Most fields are required (use Required instead).
a11y: Label linked to textarea. Optional text is on-screen but not programmatically linked.
